name: BridgeLab: ATLAS to ATT&CK Agent Identity Pivot
description: ATT&CK v19 techniques reachable when an AI agent's identity is weaponized via ATLAS manipulation techniques. Each technique annotation includes the ATLAS entry point, bridge condition, and detection opportunity.

techniques.comment:
[AML.T0080.001] AI Agent Context Poisoning: Memory
Bridge: Poisoned memory entry instructs agent to add backup credentials; agent decides to use its own OAuth token to call IAM API
Detect: IAM CreateAccessKey called by agent service principal outside scheduled rotation window
Log: AWS CloudTrail / Azure Activity Log

[AML.T0051] LLM Prompt Injection
Bridge: Injected prompt in tool output instructs agent to call privileged API; agent uses its application access token for an out-of-scope resource
Detect: Agent service principal accesses resource outside its normal scope; token used for API not in agent's declared tool list
Log: IdP audit log (Okta System Log / Entra Sign-in Log)

[AML.T0080] AI Agent Context Poisoning
Bridge: Poisoned context causes agent to authenticate to a cloud resource outside its normal operating scope using its valid cloud identity
Detect: Agent cloud identity used to access resources with no prior access history; first-seen resource access by agent principal
Log: Cloud audit log (CloudTrail / Activity Log / GCP Audit Log)

[AML.T0053] AI Agent Tool Invocation
Bridge: Agent is manipulated into invoking its IAM management tool to attach an administrator policy to its own role
Detect: IAM role-policy attachment by agent principal that elevates its own permissions; self-escalation pattern (caller == target)
Log: AWS CloudTrail IAM events / Microsoft Graph Audit Log (Entra ID directory roles)

[AML.T0110] AI Agent Tool Poisoning
Bridge: Poisoned tool contains hidden code that reads the agent's credential files and exfiltrates them to an attacker-controlled endpoint
Detect: Agent process reads credential/config files outside its normal file access pattern; outbound connection to unknown endpoint immediately after credential file read
Log: Host EDR / agent sandbox file-access log

[AML.T0083] Credentials from AI Agent Configuration
Bridge: Adversary extracts stored OAuth tokens and API keys from agent configuration via prompt injection or configuration discovery
Detect: Agent's application token used from unexpected IP or user-agent; token replay from location inconsistent with agent's known infrastructure
Log: IdP audit log / OAuth token introspection log

[AML.T0105] Escape to Host
Bridge: Agent breaks out of its sandbox or container and accesses the host operating system's identity and credentials
Detect: Agent container or sandbox process accesses host credential stores; container escape indicators followed by local account authentication
Log: Container runtime log (containerd/CRI-O) / host audit log

[AML.T0080.001] AI Agent Context Poisoning: Memory
Bridge: Poisoned memory instructs agent to disable cloud audit logging before performing sensitive operations, using its legitimate admin access
Detect: Audit-log config change by agent principal — CloudWatch Logs retention cut to the minimum (AWS) or a diagnostic setting deleted (Azure) by a non-human identity outside the logging-config change workflow
Log: AWS CloudTrail management events / Azure Activity Log / SIEM alert on log-source gap

[AML.T0104] Publish Poisoned AI Agent Tool
Bridge: Tool from a compromised registry uses the agent's own cloud identity to create a brand-new backdoor identity (App Registration / IAM user) it controls, for persistent attacker access
Detect: New App Registration / IAM user created by agent service principal; account creation by non-human identity outside provisioning workflow
Log: AWS CloudTrail / Microsoft Graph Audit Log (Entra ID) / IdP provisioning log

[AML.T0053] AI Agent Tool Invocation
Bridge: Agent is steered to read and exfiltrate sensitive data from cloud storage using its legitimate storage-reader credentials
Detect: Agent principal accesses storage bucket or blob container outside its normal pattern; bulk read operations or access to buckets with no prior agent access history
Log: S3 server access log / Azure Blob diagnostic log / GCP Cloud Audit Log
